title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf Wall Mount Solid Brass | Flat Troll Blue | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a covered toilet paper holder that combines a roll holder with a convenient glass shelf in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs. Part of the Waverly Place collection, this wall mount accessory is designed to help keep toilet tissue protected while adding a handy spot for small items.

- Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Crafted from solid brass (brass construction)
- Wall mount installation saves space; concealed screw mounting for a clean look
- Includes installation hardware
